index.html.description: Explore cost segregation reading, study-review resources and professional scope. Compare report deliverables and fees before commissioning a property study.
index.html.heading: Understand the report before commissioning a study
index.html.body:
Start with the book’s reading resources and identify the questions about property basis, study assumptions, asset schedules and preparer handoff that apply to your situation. Keep educational examples separate from the conclusions your own records support.

Review AE Tax Advisors’ book resources and published advisory scope and fees. If you need professional implementation, discuss the work required and confirm who prepares and files the relevant returns.
